title: Library Visits Fell 46%, But Borrowing Moved Online
hook: Library visits fell 46 percent, but readers moved online.
closing: Your library did not disappear; more of it simply moved onto the phone in your pocket.
question: How do you use your library?

segments.say: Library visits fell to 671 million. The buildings emptied dramatically, but reading demand did not vanish.
Library digital checkouts reached 739 million. Borrowing moved from front desks to apps.
